jobs.title: Regional General Manager, Dental Sales - Northern California
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

***Please note that this position will be managing a sales team in San Francisco and Sacramento***

This position is responsible for leading sales growth and operational excellence in their assigned geographic region, managing a territory valued at roughly $100M. This position combines leadership, sales management, and business development to drive market share, profitability, and operational efficiency. The role will oversee all field sales activities while collaborating with field operations to impact the assigned geography. This role will focus on growing sales in key markets while meeting corporate strategic objectives. The position is responsible for fostering a collaborative culture, ensuring customer-centricity, and driving sales through proactive leadership and relationship management.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Sales Growth & Market Expansion: Actively grow sales in the region through strategic initiatives, expanding market share with existing customers, and identifying new business opportunities. Lead efforts to establish primary vendor agreements (PVAs) and maintain strong relationships with key customers.
- Leadership & Coaching: Provide hands-on leadership to sales and operations teams within the region. Mentor and coach Team Schein Members (TSMs), including Field Sales Consultants (FSCs), and other regional personnel, fostering career development and high performance.
- Strategic Planning: Collaborate with senior leadership to implement strategic sales and marketing plans. Ensure the region’s goals align with broader corporate objectives and drive profitability, including margin management, expense control, and revenue growth.
- Customer Engagement & Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, vendors, and stakeholders. Regularly engage with customers to ensure satisfaction and loyalty while identifying opportunities for service improvement and expansion.
- P&L Management & Financial Accountability: Oversee the region's financial performance, managing profit and loss (P&L) statements and ensuring alignment with corporate profitability goals. Implement strategies to improve gross profit and optimize resource allocation.
- Talent Development & Recruitment: Lead recruiting efforts for sales and operations personnel, inclusive of training and onboarding responsibilities. Ensure continuous training and development programs are in place to enhance team performance in collaboration with Henry Schein corporate training department.
- Collaboration & Communication: Act as the primary liaison between corporate leadership and regional teams. Ensure effective communication of corporate initiatives, sales strategies, and competitive intelligence to drive regional success.
- Operations & Marketing Oversight: Implement national and regional marketing programs to promote growth. Work closely with operations teams to ensure efficient supply chain processes and contract compliance.
- Special Projects: Participate in key corporate projects and initiatives as directed, including participation in regional and national conventions, customer events, and company meetings.

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

- Strong business acumen with the ability to interpret financial data and implement strategies to improve profitability.
- Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with experience in presenting to board-level executives and customers.
- Proficient in strategic planning, project management, and operational efficiency.
- Knowledge of healthcare and dental industry practices, including NDSOs, CHCs, and private practices, as well as ERP systems, pricing models, and supply chain management.

GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:

- Excellent management and leadership skills and ability to attract, retain, motivate, develop and mentor team members for high performance
- Outstanding verbal and written communication skills and ability to resolve disputes effectively
- Outstanding presentation and public speaking skills
- Outstanding independent decision making, analysis and problem-solving skills
- Understand, interpret and act on financial information that contributes to business profitability
- Ability to plan and manage complex and successful projects; understand available resources, develop timeline, budget and assign areas of responsibility
- Lead teams to achieve company goals and solve complex business issues in creative and effective ways
- Outstanding planning and organizational skills and techniques
- Communicate effectively with senior management and key stakeholders
- Strong negotiating skills and ability to effectively manage internal and external relationships
- Ability to influence, build relationships, understand organizational complexities, manage conflict and navigate politics
- Broad and wide range of professional and managerial skills with a full understanding of industry practices and company policies and procedures
- Ability to lead and develop virtual teams
- Outstanding in multiple technical and business skills

MINIMUM WORK EXPERIENCE:

Typically 10 or more years of increasing responsibility and complexity in terms of any applicable professional experience; 3 or more years of management experience.

PREFERRED EDUCATION:

Typically a Bachelor's Degree or global equivalent in related discipline. Master's degree or global equivalent a plus.

TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Travel up to 50% to support regional teams within assigned geography, attend meetings, and engage with key clients and stakeholders. No special physical demands required.

- The posted range for this position is $113,962-$178,067 which is the expected starting base salary range for an employee who is new to the role to fully proficient in the role. Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including education, prior experience, training, current skills, certifications, location/labor market, internal equity, etc. At the time of this posting, this position is eligible for a bonus not reflected in the posted range subject to the achievement of the plan.
- Other benefits available include:  Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage, 401K Plan with Company Match, PTO [ or sick leave if applicable ], Paid Parental Leave, Income Protection, Work Life Assistance Program, Flexible Spending Accounts, Educational Benefits, Worldwide Scholarship Program and Volunteer Opportunities.

jobs.title: Sr. Site Manager, Operations
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The position is responsible for the overall operational performance and leadership of a facility supporting multiple business units. This role provides strategic and day-to-day leadership across warehouse operations, fulfillment, inventory management, quality, safety, and regulatory compliance within a matrix organizational structure.  The Site Leader is accountable for delivering a safe, efficient, high-quality operation that consistently meets or exceeds expectations. This position partners closely with business unit leaders and other key stakeholders to align site priorities. A key focus of the role is building a high-performing culture through strong leadership, employee engagement, continuous improvement, talent development, and focused execution. The Site Leader will identify opportunities to improve processes, increase productivity, optimize resources and reduce costs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Manage the daily operations of the site , including talent development, safety, manufacturing, warehousing, fulfillment, and distribution to achieve operational targets.

- Management of site MSO P&L, continuous focus on cost reduction and efficiency improvement.

- Develop and maintain Site metrics on cost, service, and quality, standardized with HS manufacturing site model.

- Partner with site leaders and matrix leaders to drive standardization and support the strategic consolidation model.

- Lead the site in a matrix organization with clear direction and collaboration across all functions.

- Support the execution of site strategy and ensure alignment with overall manufacturing goals to drive return.

- Contribute to the development and management of annual operating and capital expenditure

- Build and strengthen organizational capabilities and talent to support current and future business requirements.

- Recruit, develop, and evaluate employees to ensure high performance and efficient operational management .

- Ensure effective inventory control processes , including monitoring cycle count results and addressing discrepancies through corrective actions.

jobs.title: General Manager - Iberica
jobs.description:
General Summary

You will lead the commercial expansion of the BioHorizons Camlog business across Spain and Portugal, driving both revenue growth and profitability. You'll oversee a sales and marketing team, supported by back-office and logistics functions, executing our global GORG strategies with local market adaptation. This role requires close collaboration with global marketing, products & solutions, and the Henry Schein Dental partner organisation to unlock synergies and optimise market penetration.

💼 Essential Responsibilities:
Commercial & Financial Leadership:
- Lead commercial strategy and profitability across Spain and Portugal, establishing a strong foundation for sustainable growth

- Partner with finance on annual budgeting and monthly forecasting

- Conduct regular performance reviews with the Managing Director Central Europe, GORG, shaping regional strategy based on local insights

Sales & Marketing Strategy:
- Build and execute integrated sales and education strategies that resonate with local customers and market dynamics

- Develop local marketing initiatives including tailored campaigns, pricing strategies, and partnerships that reflect regional preferences

- Collaborate with the Head of DSO EMEA, GORG to capture growth opportunities in corporate and institutional healthcare

Team & Organizational Development:
- Lead and mentor a talented sales and back-office team, fostering professional growth and a collaborative work culture

- Create high-performing teams through strong relationships, clear communication, and investment in people development

- Implement sales management systems (CRM) that support efficiency and work-life balance

Strategic Market Engagement:
- Understand the unique needs, preferences, and competitive landscape of the Spanish and Portuguese markets

- Build strong, lasting relationships with partners, including Henry Schein Dental, to create mutual value and success

- Contribute strategic insights to GORG, representing the voice of your markets and identifying opportunities for innovation

🔍 Desired Qualifications:
- A Bachelor in Business or Master's degree (MBA is a plus), with 10+ years in the medical devices industry with demonstrated commercial success

- Proven track record establishing and leading high-performing sales teams with a people-centered leadership approach

- Experience thriving in matrix organizations with the ability to mobilize and inspire cross-functional teams

- Strong analytical mindset, including financial acumen and sales force analytics

- Excellent problem-solving abilities with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach

- In-depth knowledge of the Spanish market is essential. Understanding of the Portuguese market is highly valued

- Language proficiency: Business fluent in Spanish and English (verbal and written). Portuguese skills are a definite advantage

- Natural ability to build trust and develop long-term business relationships

- Comfortable communicating across hierarchies and fostering open dialogue

- Significant travel within assigned markets (40–60%)

Compensation & Benefits
- Very competitive gross annual salary and bonus

- Hybrid working model

- €110 monthly meal allowance (January to November)

- 24 working days of annual leave, plus 24 December, 31 December and your birthday off

- Summer working hours during July and August (8:00 am – 3:00 pm)

- Private health insurance

- Life insurance

- Christmas gift hamper

- Continuous learning and professional development opportunities

- International career opportunities within a global healthcare leader

- A collaborative, inclusive and people-focused culture where your ideas and contributions matter

Why Henry Schein?
At Henry Schein, you'll be joining an organization where people make the difference. You'll have the opportunity to work alongside talented professionals in an international environment, contribute to meaningful projects and build a career with a company that invests in your growth.

We value collaboration, integrity, innovation and continuous learning, empowering our teams to create a positive impact for our customers, our colleagues and the healthcare professionals we serve.

Diversity & Inclusion
Henry Schein is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued and empowered to succeed. We believe that different perspectives drive better ideas, stronger teams and greater innovation.
If you're ready to make an impact while continuing to grow your career, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of Team Schein

jobs.title: Functional Process Leader, GBS - Financial Planing & Analysis (FP&A)
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW:
This role owns global service delivery performance for Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) processes within Global Business Services (GBS), ensuring high-quality, accurate, and efficient execution across outsourced and retained operations.

The Functional Process Lead is accountable for operational delivery, vendor performance, and stakeholder alignment for FP&A activities, ensuring execution aligns with global process standards established by the Corporate Finance Global Process Lead (GPL), while meeting function-specific planning, reporting, and analytical requirements.

The role serves as the primary interface between Corporate Finance leadership, outsourced delivery partners, and GBS teams for FP&A service delivery.

Reports to the Corporate Finance Global Process Lead and is responsible for global execution and service delivery performance for FP&A processes, operating within the strategic framework defined by the Corporate Finance Global Process Lead.

KEY RESPONSIBILI TIES:
- Serve as the primary global interface between Corporate Finance stakeholders (CFO, finance leadership, and business unit planning teams), GBS, and outsourced delivery partners, ensuring alignment of service delivery with functional priorities and reporting requirements
- Own end-to-end global service delivery performance for FP&A processes, ensuring consistent, high-quality execution across delivery teams
- Translate functional business requirements into operational delivery plans, aligned with global process standards and governance frameworks defined by the GPL
- Lead daily and weekly operating cadence globally, managing volume, quality, throughput, and delivery performance across outsourced and retained teams
- Own and enforce SLA and KPI performance, including forecast accuracy, budget cycle timeliness, management reporting turnaround, and variance analysis quality; proactively identify risks and escalate issues to the GPL with root cause analysis and corrective action plans
- Own delivery of the planning and reporting calendar, ensuring budget, forecast, and management reporting cycles are executed on time and to the required standard across all geographies
- Act as the primary escalation point for service delivery issues related to FP&A processes, ensuring timely resolution of data quality issues, reporting delays, and analytical exceptions
- Own vendor service delivery outcomes for FP&A, including SLA performance, quality, and accuracy, ensuring outsourced operations meet functional standards
- Support demand forecasting and capacity planning, aligning resources with planning cycle peaks and proactively escalating risks to the GPL
- Maintain structured exception management and escalation frameworks aligned with global governance standards
- Identify opportunities for process improvement, reporting automation, and standardization, and partner with the GPL and Process Excellence teams to prioritize and implement enhancements
- Support transition, stabilization, and post-Day 1 onboarding activities for new scope migrations into GBS or outsourced environments

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:
- Deep subject matter expertise in FP&A, including strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, management reporting, variance analysis, and business partnering practices

- Experience supporting or driving process improvements, including automation of reporting workflows, planning tool implementations, and standardization of FP&A processes
- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities with high attention to detail

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Service & Technical Support
jobs.description:
Don’t just work somewhere, join Brasseler and be a valued team member of a world-class health care organization!

Our Culture:
Provides a safe and welcoming environment where team members can balance their lives and develop their careers. All people and experiences are valued and respected. Different perspectives are encouraged and lead to better results. This makes us who we are and enables us to be a world-class healthcare organization. All who join us are accountable to this charge.

Our Philosophy:
Quality products sold with integrity has been the hallmark of Brasseler USA from the beginning. Brasseler USA’s strong reputation of providing high quality, clinician endorsed and innovative dental and medical instrumentation nationally has spanned over 40 years. We have been offering a full-range of products made in the USA since 1976. Many of our products are manufactured at our headquarters in Savannah, GA.

Explore our career opportunities below to learn more.

This position is responsible for the design and execution of the end-to-end process of the service and support operation from in-house to field activities. This includes supplier relationships, warranty management, customer support and processes that enable optimized customer experience. The role is responsible for post-sale technical support for the product line: resolution of customer-reported issues in the field, a service center staffed by technicians providing technical phone support and partnering with service and repair team handling warranty and out-of-warranty repairs on site. This is a technical leadership position in the areas of electro-mechanical, opto- electronics and pneumatics This position ensures adherence to all QSR’s.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Design and direct operational flow from in house to field service. Includes leading process improvement initiatives using Lean techniques and tools.
- Manages the service center technical support team providing phone-based troubleshooting to customers and field sales representatives. Sets coverage, call handling standards and response time expectations, and maintains troubleshooting guides, FAQs and support training materials
- Team oversight and development plan for team members ensuring a team focused on metrics driven results and continuous improvement. Selects, develops and evaluates staff to ensure efficient operation of repair and service.
- Serves as the escalation point for customer-reported product issues in the field. Drives investigation, root cause analysis and corrective action with Engineering, Quality and Manufacturing, and closes the loop with the customer.
- Develops and executes system drives unit traceability from site through to field.
- Develop plans for efficient management of spare parts, ensuring system solutions as per site standardized practices. Partners with purchasing for system process design and execution.
- Owns the warranty and RMA process end to end, including return authorization, receipt and evaluation, repair or replace decisions, warranty cost tracking and credit issuance.
- Defines and reports KPIs such as first contact resolution, call volume and abandonment rate, repair turnaround time, repair backlog, warranty cost as a percent of sales and repeat repair rate. Uses the data to target product and process improvements
- Ensures field and service center activity feeds the complaint handling system, that complaints are captured, triaged and escalated for MDR and vigilance reportability decisions per procedure, and that repair records and device history records are maintained.
- Partners with Sales, Marketing and Customer Service on service offerings, service and repair pricing, escalation paths and customer communication for field actions.
- Partnering with financial partner to ensure cost model to support operation and adherence to aligned cost model and budget.
- Ensures adherence to Company policies and procedures.
- Ensures quality of products is maintained, and safety procedures, Federal and State regulations and Company guidelines are followed
- Participates in special projects and performs other duties as required.

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

- ISO 9001 and 13485 experience
- Experience in medical device manufacturing of Class 1 and 2, devices,
- Effective Continuous Process Improvement Experience
- Lean Manufacturing Background
- Successful experience in integrating new products into the manufacturing process
- Logistics experience required
- Service management and CRM systems for case management, RMA tracking and installed base records preferred.
- Repair experience with handpieces or comparable small electro-mechanical and pneumatic devices preferred

GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:

jobs.title: CN Finance Manager
jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE:
Finance Manager - JV
DEPARTMENT:
Finance
LOCATION:
Wuhan
ISSUED:

REPORTS TO:
JV Finance Controller / Managing Director
FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS WITH:
Provide Support To :
- Local Management team
- Local Sales/Marketing for business support
- Local Operations for policy implementation

Receives Guidance From:
- JV Finance Controller
- China CFO
- Managing Director

REPORTS INCLUDE:
Total Finance team
SIGNIFICANT CONTACT WITH:
- Management team
- Internal departments (finance/sales/customer service/purchase team)

POSITION OVERVIEW

This position is the senior Financial Leader for Hongchang.  Key responsibilities include US GAAP reporting, statutory and local management reporting, compliance including tax and internal controls, planning and analysis for the business along with being strong communication link between the business and Henry Schein. The role will operate as a business partner to the Managing Director and participate in regular business/budget/forecast reviews with the wider Henry Schein Group.

Job Description

Accounting & Tax
Be responsible for PRC and US GAAP monthly reporting within specific monthly time frame. Organize the monthly/ quarterly/annual closing and balance sheet reconciliations to make sure accuracy and timeliness of bookkeeping. Monitor the VAT invoice report and reconcile with the purchase and sales at month end. Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual tax returns (VAT, income tax…). Work closely with the external auditors on annual audit. Work closely with the operation on annual physical count.

Internal control and risk management
Monitor the credit information of the customers and conduct credit control for the daily business. Work with the operation team to ensure the safeguard of inventory, including regular and consignment stock checks. Review the implementation of internal control system, including ICIS and China group policies. Quarterly sampling and testing SOX controls and document the evidence for review. Identify and analyze the risks, and report on exceptional cases to senior management if necessary.

Statutory and group /local report
Prepare the statutory report for local authorities and external stakeholders. Assist in the preparation of group reports including both financial and non-financial information. Prepare monthly reports for the group and local management’s needs within agreed timeframe. Provide the information for JV Finance Controller for group reports purpose.

Management report & controlling
Review FCPA payment application and monitor the compliance. Prepare the local monthly business Review deck. Take the initiative to develop performance measures to push the healthy growth of the company. Prepare ad hoc analysis where required.

Treasury
Prepare monthly cash flow forecast for the company. Work closely with JV Finance Controller on working capital management and treasury requirements.

Business planning & Operations
Take the lead to prepare the Company budget, and monitor / control the budget. Liaise with the different business units to prepare monthly financial forecast. Support the Managing Director with financial analysis on all investment decisions. Monitor productivity levels in the operation. Support the Managing Director in supplier negotiations and assist in the management of gross profit margins.

POSITION DEMANDS

- This position will be based in Wuhan.
- The key success of the role is to assure high quality & timely accounting & financial information while also enhancing and ensure compliance of the Company’s internal control policies You will be expected to act as a Business Partner to the Managing Director to help advance the business growth opportunities where possible.

QUALIFICATIONS & ATTRIBUTES
EXPERIENCE
- At least 10 years in an Accounting/Finance senior role with a proven track record of achievements.
- You may have worked in one of the top 4 audit firms at the start of your career.

EDUCATION
- Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business or relevant major
